intro: Cinq Tall Display Unit transforms vertical space into curated storage. Elevated on a tubular steel frame and finished in a neutral tone, it blends concealed capacity with glass-fronted elegance.

features.title: Sleek neutral design for contemporary settings
features.text: Cinq’s clean silhouette and light finish make it suitable for living rooms, dining areas, or entryways. Its modern aesthetic allows the unit to blend seamlessly with surrounding décor.

features.title: Elegant tubular steel frame for elevated poise
features.text: The cinq display unit’s slim steel legs lift the structure visually, giving it a refined, airy presence while maintaining durability.

features.title: Glass-fronted display for curated presentation
features.text: The transparent front panel allows you to showcase crockery, books, or decorative pieces. It balances protection with visibility, adding sophistication to storage.

features.title: Ample internal storage for organised living
features.text: Behind the glass and within the unit lies a generous capacity for everyday essentials. It accommodates both display-worthy pieces and practical storage.

features.title: Modular system for cohesive interiors
features.text: Designed as part of the Cinq modular rhythm, the unit aligns proportionally with other modules, enabling flexible combinations over time.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
